theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_lsa_lipschitz_image_lintegral_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (D : Set (Euclid m)) (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzOnWith Λ G D → (∀ N ⊆ D, μHE[m] (G '' N) ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * volume N) ∧ (MeasurableSet D → ∀ H : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable H → ∫⁻ x in G '' D, H x ∂μHE[m] ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * ∫⁻ a in D, H (G a))
